checks.lead: Philip I (Latin: Marcus Julius Philippus; c. 204 – September 249), commonly known as Philip the Arab, was the Roman emperor from 244 to 249. Although his reign lasted only five years, it marked an unusually stable period during the Crisis of the Third Century.
